obligation: Utility incident notice (9 addendum utilities with a 24-hour term)
citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 1 (contract term; flows down CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.1)
trigger: Company confirms a cyber incident related to the products or services it supplies to the utility (TMU configuration software, supplied firmware, field service access, or the FMS for subscribers) that poses cyber security risk to the utility
deadline: Within 24 hours after confirmation (contract deadline, not a NERC requirement)
notify: Each utility's designated security contact by the method in its addendum
clock_starts: Confirmation of an incident related to supplied products or services (decision D2 in the runbooks)
owner: General Counsel (sends); Contracts and Trade Compliance Manager (prepares)
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

obligation: Utility incident notice (22 addendum utilities with a 48-hour term)
citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 1 (CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.1 flow-down)
trigger: Same as above
deadline: Within 48 hours after confirmation (contract deadline)
clock_starts: Confirmation of an incident related to supplied products or services
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

obligation: Utility response coordination
citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 2 (CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.2 flow-down)
trigger: Any incident notified under sec. 1
deadline: Ongoing until closure; share indicators and recovery steps for supplied products and services
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

obligation: Utility access-revocation notice
citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 3 (CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.3 flow-down)
trigger: A company representative's remote or onsite access to a utility should no longer be granted (termination, transfer, or credentials that may be compromised, such as a stolen field laptop)
deadline: Within 1 business day
notify: Each utility where the person holds access
clock_starts: Termination date, transfer date, or discovery that credentials may be compromised
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

obligation: Utility vulnerability disclosure
citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 4 (CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.4 flow-down)
trigger: The company knows of a vulnerability in firmware or software it supplied (including the TMU configuration software)
deadline: Within 30 days of the company knowing of it
notify: Addendum utility security contacts; also published to all TMU and FMS customers
clock_starts: Date the vulnerability is reported to or found by the company (logged at intake)
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

obligation: Integrity information for replacement software or firmware
citation: Utility Supplier Cyber Security Addendum sec. 5 (CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.5 flow-down)
trigger: A release is re-signed, a signing certificate is revoked, or a replacement firmware image is issued
deadline: With each replacement release, before utilities install it
notify: Addendum utility security contacts; download portal
verified: true (CIP-013-2 text); contract terms per scenario

obligation: FMS subscriber security incident notice
trigger: Confirmed security incident affecting a subscriber's data or the FMS service
deadline: Within 72 hours after confirmation
owner: Director of Digital Services with the General Counsel

obligation: FMS service availability notice
trigger: Portal or alerting outage
deadline: Status page within 1 hour; service credits if monthly availability falls below 99.5%

obligation: Delivery-impact notice to utility and developer customers
trigger: Production delay affecting committed or storm-restoration deliveries
deadline: Per each supply agreement (as soon as the delay is known)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - business and contractual, not legal

obligation: Federal contracting officer: delivery impact
citation: Federal contract terms; FAR 52.204-21 has no incident reporting paragraph
trigger: Incident delays deliveries under a federal contract or affects FCI
deadline: No cyber incident reporting duty under FAR 52.204-21. Notify of any delivery schedule impact under the contract's terms (confirm with counsel)

obligation: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment identified
trigger: Covered equipment identified during response, rebuild, or replacement purchases
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification; further information within 10 business days

obligation: Kaspersky covered article identified
trigger: A Kaspersky Lab covered article is identified in anything provided to the Government or used under the contract
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification; further information within 10 business days

obligation: FASCSA covered article identified
trigger: A covered article or source subject to an applicable FASCSA order was provided to the Government or used during contract performance
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification; further information within 10 business days
notify: Contracting office named in the clause

obligation: Florida breach notice to individuals
trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents (employee and applicant HR, payroll, and applicant tracking records)
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach or reason to believe a breach occurred; 15 additional days only if good cause is given in writing to the Department within 30 days (applies to this notice only); law enforcement delay on written request
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if employee or applicant personal information was accessed
clock_starts: Determination of the breach or reason to believe one occurred
owner: HR Director with the General Counsel

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach (no extension for this notice)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if 500 or more Florida individuals (850 employees plus former employees and applicants)

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice required to more than 1,000 individuals at a single time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
clock_starts: Decision to notify more than 1,000 individuals

obligation: Third-party agent breach notice to the company (inbound)
trigger: The HR, payroll, or applicant tracking SaaS provider, the MSSP, or another third-party agent has a breach of the company's personal information
deadline: Agent must notify the company within 10 days after determining the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - track for HR SaaS, payroll, and the MSSP

obligation: Other states' breach laws
citation: State breach notification statutes (each state where affected individuals reside)
trigger: Affected employees or applicants who live outside Florida
deadline: Varies by state
notify: Residents and regulators under each state's law
applies_at_this_tier: Check residency of affected individuals; counsel applies each state's law

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
trigger: Considering a ransom payment
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party is involved); FBI or CISA

obligation: Voluntary report to law enforcement and CISA
trigger: Ransomware or a compromise of supplied products or services confirmed
deadline: As soon as practicable (target within 24 hours of declaration)
notify: FBI field office or IC3; CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - voluntary; supports OFAC mitigation, utility coordination, and sector sharing

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident and ransom payment reports (PROPOSED - not in effect)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment
deadline: Proposed only: 72 hours after reasonable belief a covered cyber incident occurred; 24 hours after a ransom payment
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-10-05. If finalized as proposed, the company would be covered under both the size and the manufacturing criteria. Report voluntarily now
clock_starts: Not applicable until a final rule is effective

obligation: DoD cyber incident reporting
trigger: Cyber incident affecting covered defense information
deadline: 72 hours
applies_at_this_tier: No - no DoD contracts or subcontracts; recorded for completeness

obligation: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
trigger: Material cybersecurity incident at an SEC registrant
deadline: 4 business days after a materiality determination
applies_at_this_tier: No - privately held; recorded for completeness

obligation: Cyber insurance claim notice
trigger: Suspected security incident
deadline: Call the carrier breach hotline before hiring any incident vendor
notify: Carrier breach hotline (breach counsel, forensics, OT-capable response firm)

obligation: Audit committee chair and private equity sponsor
citation: POL-03 4.7 (company rule); credit agreement material-event notice (contract)
trigger: Severity 1 incident
deadline: Audit committee chair within 24 hours of declaration; sponsor's operating partner at the same time; lenders per the credit agreement as counsel advises
notify: Audit committee chair; sponsor operating partner; lenders

obligation: MSSP high-severity escalation to the company (inbound)
trigger: High-severity alert
deadline: Call to the Security Manager within 30 minutes

obligation: TMU electronics supplier advisory to the company (inbound)
trigger: Supplier learns of a vulnerability or compromise affecting TMU firmware
deadline: No deadline in the current agreement; a 10-business-day term is being added at renewal (POAM-012)
